sources.entry: svg.io - The power of AI with our Free Text-to-SVG Generator! Effortlessly convert your text prompts into stunning SVG images using our advanced AI technology. #free

summary.name: SVG.io (now PicTrix.ai)
summary.one_liner: SVG.io is a text-to-SVG AI image generator whose memberships have been migrated to PicTrix.ai, with plans mapped from SVG.io Free, Lite, and Pro to PicTrix Free, Lite, and Pro.
use_cases: Generate SVG icons or graphics from text prompts
Create pixel art or grayscale SVG images
Make color SVG images on a paid plan
Move an existing SVG.io membership to a PicTrix plan
Use API access for production integrations via the Business plan
summary.what_it_does: The page announces that SVG.io users have been moved to PicTrix.ai, with existing memberships transferred to equivalent plans. It lists three tiers: PicTrix Free (10 free credits per day, personal public use, small sizes, pixel and grayscale SVG), PicTrix Lite (500 credits per month, medium sizes, color SVG), and PicTrix Pro (1200 credits per month, commercial use, private images, large sizes). The platform is described as offering newer models, pixel, grayscale and color SVG output from one account, and prompt enhancement, image guides and seed controls. API access is now only mentioned as part of the PicTrix Business plan.
notable: SVG.io memberships were mapped to equivalent PicTrix Free, Lite and Pro plans
Outputs pixel, grayscale SVG and color SVG from the same workflow
API access moved to the PicTrix Business plan
Free tier gives 10 credits per day after registration
caveats: Free tier is limited to personal, public generations with small sizes and no color SVG
API access requires the PicTrix Business plan; pricing for it is not stated on the page
Commercial use and private images require the Pro plan
